title: Virgo: your money
in 2027, month by month
summary: Why money has been slipping out for a Virgo Moon since October, your earning window from late January to late June 2027, and how the year ends.
imageAlt: Maya holding a Virgo flag, with the maiden beside her and a jar of coins at her feet
inside: Why money has felt slippery since late October 2026
Your earning window: late January to late June 2027
The dates that matter for your money, in one table
Four things to do in each stretch, and what to leave alone
intro: If your Moon is in Virgo, you may have noticed money leaving faster than it arrives since the end of October: bills, gifts, a trip, the things other people needed. The film says why in sixty seconds. This guide gives the dates, what the tradition reads in each stretch of 2027, and how to use them.

A note before you start. This is read from your Moon sign, and it is what the tradition says about a period, said as a tendency and never as a promise. Your own chart, your work and your choices shape how much of it you recognise. Nothing here is financial advice.

sections.label: What has been happening
title: The generous planet
in your house of spending.
paragraphs: On October 31, 2026, Jupiter moved into Leo. Counted from a Virgo Moon, Leo is the twelfth house: the house of spending, rest, far places and letting go. Jupiter stays there until January 23, 2027.

Jupiter is the generous planet. In the twelfth house his generosity tends to flow outwards: money goes to other people, to comfort, to travel, to the things you could not say no to. That is why it can feel as if money slips through your fingers even when nothing is wrong.
The tradition does not read this as loss. It reads it as giving and resting, and it is a short stretch. Less than three months after it began, the same planet turns towards your income.

sections.label: The earning window
title: Late January
to late June 2027.
paragraphs: On January 24, 2027, Jupiter moves into Cancer, the eleventh house from a Virgo Moon: the house of gains, income from many sources, friends and networks, and wishes met. He stays until June 24. Cancer is the sign where Jupiter is said to be at his strongest.

This is read as your earning window for the year: extra income, a side project that finally pays, help or an introduction from a friend, a request that gets a yes. The eleventh house is about what comes in, so this is the stretch to ask, to offer, and to say yes to sensible chances.

There is a second guest in the same house. From December 5, 2026, Ketu, the south node, sits in Cancer too, and stays there until June 22, 2028. Ketu is calm and detached. In the house of gains he is read as gains that come without the chase: you do not need to grab at every opportunity, and the ones that fit tend to find you.

sections.label: Your money dates
title: The dates
that matter.
paragraphs: The dates below are US Eastern time. Each line says where the planets that matter for money are for a Virgo Moon, and how that stretch is read.

rows.note: Jupiter in your twelfth house. Money flows out to rest, gifts and other people. Read as a short giving stretch, not a loss.

rows.v: Ketu to your house of gains
rows.note: Ketu, the south node, moves into Cancer, your eleventh house, until June 22, 2028. Read as calm, steady gains you do not have to chase.
Jupiter in Cancer, your eleventh house. Your earning window: extra income, help from friends, wishes met.
Jupiter back in Leo, your twelfth house. Read as money for rest, travel and the people you love. A time to enjoy and to keep a little aside.
Jupiter moves into Virgo, your first house, until February 27, 2028, and comes back to it from July 24, 2028. Read as a fresh start for you and the way you handle money.

after: Jupiter changes sign about once a year, but in 2026 and 2027 he moves back and forth between Leo and Cancer before settling into Virgo. That is why your spending house and your gains house take turns.

items.name: Saturn in your house of partners
items.text: Saturn has been in Pisces, your seventh house, since March 29, 2025. For money this is read as care with shared money and with agreements: what you sign with a partner, a client or a spouse. From June 2 to October 18, 2027 he steps into Aries, your eighth house of shared resources, then returns to Pisces on October 19 and leaves for good on February 23, 2028.

items.name: Rahu in your house of joy
items.text: From December 5, 2026, Rahu, the north node, sits in Capricorn, your fifth house of joy, creativity and play. The tradition reads Rahu as appetite, so here he is said to pull towards quick thrills. Keep the fun for fun, and keep your savings out of anything that feels like a gamble.

steps.name: Go easy on yourself until late January
steps.text: Money leaving in the last months of 2026 is read as the twelfth house doing its job. Notice where it goes, cut the leaks you can see, and do not judge yourself for the rest. The turn is close.

steps.name: Say yes in spring
steps.text: Between late January and late June 2027 the generous planet sits in your house of gains. That is the stretch to raise your rates, take the extra project, answer the friend who mentions an opening, or finally ask for what you are owed.

steps.name: Keep a little aside for summer
steps.text: From late June to late November 2027 Jupiter is back in your house of spending. Put part of what comes in during the spring aside before it arrives, so the summer can go on rest and the people you love without worry.

steps.name: Do not chase
steps.text: With calm Ketu in your house of gains, the tradition says the best money comes from steady work and good relationships, not from grabbing at every chance. Choose a few things and do them well.

faq.q: Is this for my Sun sign or my Moon sign?
faq.a: Your Moon sign. Vedic astrology reads timing from the sign the Moon was in when you were born, which is often different from the Sun sign most people know. Your birth chart shows it in a few seconds.

faq.q: Does this mean I will earn more in 2027?
faq.a: No one can promise that. The tradition reads late January to late June 2027 as the most supportive stretch for income for a Virgo Moon. It is the best time to ask and to say yes, and the asking is still yours to do.

faq.q: Why does Jupiter go back into Leo in June?
faq.a: Jupiter is moving fast through these signs in 2026 and 2027, in Cancer from June 1, 2026, Leo from October 31, Cancer again from January 24, 2027, Leo from June 25, and Virgo from November 26, 2027. For a Virgo Moon that means the house of spending, then gains, then spending again, then your own sign.

note: Dates are US Eastern time. Vedic (sidereal) astrology, Lahiri ayanamsa, read by Moon sign. Not financial advice.
